caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware jar with a light brown, earthy color. The jar has two small, vertically-oriented handles located on either side near the upper rim. It is illustrated standing upright and appears to have a slightly wider top opening with a pronounced rim. The surface of the jar features a black, sketched decorative motif on the front, consisting of a stylized human face with curly hair, simple facial features, and two wings, giving the appearance of an angel. Above this motif, there is an inscription that reads "POTTERY WORKS" in small, uppercase letters, accompanied by some additional writing and symbols, including stars and what looks like “LIT” and “16” or “1/6.” The drawing is centered on a cream-colored background within a faint rectangular border, and the artist's signature, "F. Fumagalli," appears in the lower right outside the actual illustration of the jar.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
